summaries.senate: The sharpest move today came in [[Michigan]], where the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed saw a steep drop in their chances. In [[Alaska]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Mary Peltola gained ground by a moderate amount. The Republican Ashley Hinson also strengthened in Iowa, with a moderate rise in Polymarket odds.
summaries.governor: Three governor's races saw moderate gains for the leader, all of them shown as predicted flips: [[Georgia]], where the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained ground, [[Kansas]], where the Republican Ty Masterson improved, and [[Alaska]], where the Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins moved up. In Texas, the Republican Greg Abbott also saw a moderate rise in Polymarket odds.
summaries.house: The biggest move in the House today was in [[FL-13 (Clearwater & Largo)]], where Polymarket odds show a sizable rise in the chances of the Republican, Anna Paulina Luna. Elsewhere, the market shows a moderate slip for the Republican in [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], Brad Knott. The Republican in [[TX-23 (Del Rio & Eagle Pass)]], Brandon Herrera, also saw a moderate decline.
